description: A GitLens-style commit graph with inline blame, commit details and read-only diff previews.
graphPageSizeDescription: Number of commits loaded per page in the Git graph. The graph asks for another page when you choose Load More.
graphAvatarsEnabledDescription: Show commit author photos in the Git graph and commit details. Uses the GitHub account you are already signed in with, and falls back to initials when no session or photo exists; no sign-in prompt is shown.
graphAvatarsProviderDescription: Where author photos come from. `github` uses the GitHub session and commit API; `gravatar` sends a hashed author email to Gravatar without any GitHub access.
blameEnabledDescription: Show author and relative date annotations at the end of every line in the active editor. Uses read-only git blame.
